tools.description: Get personalized product and variant recommendations based on customer intent, budget, recipient profile, and room type. tools.name: search_policies_and_faqs
tools.description: Search Bolot Studio FAQs and store policies. Covers product questions, sizing, finishes, shipping, returns, and ordering.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare Bolot Studio products — Legacy Print vs Cinematic Print, or a Bolot product vs typical alternatives. For photo prints, 'vs_competitors' compares against Displate, canvas and framed prints. For a house number or address sign question, use 'vs_competitors' with product_handle 'the-address-sign

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get Bolot Studio brand information, the market-visible catalogue (photo prints and The Address Sign house number sign), shipping zones, payment methods, and configurator URLs per product. Essential context for helping customers.

tools.name: check_photo_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether supplied pixel dimensions meet the print-contract 120 DPI hard gate used by upload. Returns per-size required_px. Crop and artefacts are still reviewed in the configurator. With a delivery country, also lists market-visible wall formats. If width/height are omitted, reports that suitab

tools.name: get_shipping_estimate
tools.description: Get estimated delivery time, free shipping threshold, and carrier information for a specific country. Use this when a customer asks about shipping costs or delivery times to their location.

tools.name: get_reviews_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated customer review statistics and featured review excerpts. Use this when a customer asks about product quality, other customers' experiences, or social proof. Returns ratings, distribution, and highlighted reviews.

tools.name: start_configuration
tools.description: Generate a direct URL to the Bolot Studio product configurator with pre-selected options. Optionally pre-select size and/or finish ('matte' or 'glossy'). tools.name: search_products_task
tools.description: Task-based product search for long-running MCP clients. Use task polling to retrieve the result.

tools.name: check_photo_compatibility_task
tools.description: Task-based photo-resolution check against the print-contract 120 DPI hard gate used by upload. Omit width/height to report that suitability cannot be verified without dimensions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_store_info, get_reviews_summary · Public sink: search_products, check_photo_compatibility, check_photo_compatibility_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_store_info, get_reviews_summary · Public sink: search_products, check_photo_compatibility, check_photo_compatibility_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
